source_delta: Only src/application.cj run() removes pre-feed expiry (2 insertions/10 deletions); two independent frozen tests added. Product src/native/macros/cjpm.toml f48->c862 has empty diff.

scopes.evidence: 1150 headless repetitions: 350 old snapshot, 350 pre-fix M2 snapshot, 350 M2 diagnostic, 100 eligible same-library M1 diagnostic
scopes.call_scope: startHeadless -> workload setup/action -> snapshot or eligible render -> afterSnapshot -> dispose; ordinary and initial headless never call Application.run/readByte/KeyboardDecoder. observeTiming inner bracket excludes observations; initial bracket includes scene creation/startHeadless/first snapshot with fresh lifecycle.
scopes.valid: Unchanged source/method/functional and measured render-window work, Cell slots, wall and bounded SDK heap/GC evidence under original identities; same-library eligibility remains 10 scenarios, not all stateful cases.
scopes.limits: Not device idle, TTY startup, native output, or direct measurement of new ELF.

scopes.evidence: Whole-process wait4 CPU/wall/RSS accompanying 1150 headless rows
scopes.call_scope: process_cost fork/exec/wait4 includes loading/setup/warmup/sampling/export/dispose, not only measured render loop; Application.run is not invoked.
scopes.valid: Existing quantitative unchanged-headless-path evidence remains usable at E147 with explicit artifact/version attribution; the changed device-loop function is outside executed source path.
scopes.limits: New CJP/ELF differs. No immutable executable claim, no relabeling as new-ELF actual CPU/RSS, no subtracting or silently equating startup overhead to loop CPU; F1/F3 required.

scopes.evidence: 216 product runs, 144 old/new Cell-caret comparisons, 216 metadata joins; 36 scenarios and 2 sizes
scopes.call_scope: Public headless snapshot/render and independent geometry/caret expectations; product/native/macros source f48->c862 unchanged; c862->d7 changes only run() timeout and adds tests.
scopes.valid: Previously validated headless frame/caret/business semantics and join coverage remain relevant to final unchanged rendering source.
scopes.limits: No implication of device input ordering, real-host rendering/output phase correctness or new-CJP independent consumability.

scopes.call_scope: Unchanged frozen M1 package/ELF, same ordinary CLI/observer/hosts/settings.
scopes.valid: Original baseline whole-process CPU/wall/RSS and observed functional/counter facts.
scopes.limits: Do not retag source. Host/configuration changes require relevant comparability assessment.

scopes.evidence: 175 successful pre-fix M2 CPU runs plus original VTE 160x48 vertical_panels failure
scopes.call_scope: Application.run includes changed pre-feed guard for every ready byte (removed waitingIdle call even for ordinary ASCII), extra clock/deadline work for pending sequence, and startup probe traffic; wait4 covers entire execution.
scopes.valid: Historical observations and unchanged rendering-method context; successful samples stay successful for their old source, failure stays failure.
scopes.limits: Cannot stand in for final M2 whole-process CPU, startup/initial or idle cost; old successful batches do not prove fixed native sequence handling. F4 finite 176-row refresh.

scopes.evidence: Separate native output observations / attribution work
scopes.call_scope: Encoder/diff/native writer source unchanged, but input/probe ordering may alter initial cursor and resize output, event timing and lifecycle phase attribution.
scopes.valid: Source-level encoding method and any individually valid unchanged-M1 raw facts can be reused.
scopes.limits: No blanket final-M2 write/byte-count reuse; all-thread output attribution must be independently valid; F5 existing table remains.

fresh_obligations.scope: Final source package and ordinary consumers
fresh_obligations.required: Bind final integrated source tree, CJP, freshly consumed compat and diagnostic ELF, SDK/native/dependencies/configuration and commands in a NEW admission manifest. Consume the actual 05c994... source package with the existing ordinary build entry. Existing author direct-source ELF and bundle evidence may support this but is not a clean-package independent execution. Run the normal consumer smoke already required for final artifact admission; do not rerun 1150 measurements or 216 correctness runs solely because a commit/ELF changed.
fresh_obligations.completion: No final artifact identity is inferred from old admission.json or new-provenance.json.

fresh_obligations.required: Independent execution of both exact frozen queued_input cases against the admitted final consumer; retain positive pressure/readiness/native bytes, actual positive idle poll, expected product exits, and termios restoration. Complete the separately assigned affected keyboard device/runtime integration checks, including partial expiry, EOF buffered tail/finish, stop/signals and callback cleanup, using existing public fixtures. Reuse unchanged pure decoder/native ABI checks where their source/deps/configuration match; no new parser, hooks or redundant whole-product run required.
fresh_obligations.completion: Author GREEN records are reviewed factual development evidence, not independent full-suite acceptance. Clock-failure branch is unchanged and source-reviewed; reuse its accepted evidence unless a relevant change or new failure appears.

fresh_obligations.required: Attach this source/call-scope admission to the existing 1150 raw records and 216 correctness results, retaining all original run/source/CJP/ELF identities and the custody aliases. Verify F1 dependency/configuration continuity; a changed dependency, optimization or workload requires reassessment of that affected scope.
fresh_obligations.completion: No fresh headless performance sweep required for this run-only repair. Existing whole-process CPU/wall/RSS remain observations of the named old executable; do not present them as fresh measurements of the new ELF or as inner-loop CPU.

fresh_obligations.required: Execute the already-frozen M2 CPU table on final admitted compat: XTerm 398 and VTE 0.80.1, 80x24 and 160x48, all 36 scenarios, one run for each of 34 ordinary scenarios and five for each initial/idle scenario: 176 successful final-M2 runs. Keep the 175 successful pre-fix M2 rows and original VTE vertical_panels failure as historical data. Reuse the 176 successful unchanged M1 CPU rows under their existing identities/configuration; do not rerun them just to pair a new label. Retain actual wait4 whole-process CPU/wall/RSS separately from internal loop wall/counters.
fresh_obligations.completion: Includes real-host recurrence of original VTE 160x48 vertical_panels startup path; genuine idle uses normal run after stabilization, no forced snapshot; initial preserves fresh lifecycles. New failures trigger only their affected diagnosis.

fresh_obligations.scope: Actual native output and remaining real-host acceptance
fresh_obligations.required: Complete the pre-existing 288-case native output table after independent attribution repair: 2 hosts x 2 sizes x 36 scenarios x 2 versions. Final-M2 side has 144 newly bound cases; M1 side needs only its still-unfulfilled/invalid attribution evidence, reusing any already valid same-scope capture. Include initial lifecycles, steady idle, native all-thread write/writev lineage/FD identity, requested vs successful bytes/calls/short/EINTR, and baseline/update/exit phases. Keep undisturbed CPU and instrumented output in separate processes.
fresh_obligations.completion: This preflight does not adjudicate the separate native attribution repair or count existing partial traces as accepted. Original source review is not blocked on that work. Broader six-host/Linux final acceptance remains its existing task, not an added E146 precondition.

global_limits: No AC022/031, E147, Linux, release or whole-performance acceptance.
No builds/tests/GUI/TTY/probes/decompression performed by this review.
Only safe independent diagnosis report/index read; quarantined environment trace never accessed.
Reuse does not rename raw data, replace counterexamples, or assert changed ELF equality.
No new arbitrary speed threshold or full-process allocated-byte prerequisite added.
